evidence.field: 妈 entry; 字形结构 / 字形分析 / 基本解释 / 详细解释
evidence.text: The entry for 妈 (U+5988) identifies it as a left-right graph analyzed as 形声；从女、马声. It lists mother and female-elder address senses without marking them obsolete, supporting current use. This directly supports a current-form decomposition and the 女 semantic and 马 phonetic analysis; it does not establish ancient graphic history.
evidence.title: 妈 mā — 汉典

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: A00958 媽; 字樣說明; 釋義
evidence.text: The entry specifies current 媽 as left 女 and right 馬, notes that it is not recorded in Shuowen, and cites 龍龕手鑑．女部：「媽，母也」. It also lists address senses for a mother, female elders of the mother's generation, servants in northern usage, and older women. This corroborates the traditional graph’s present components and the dictionary-cited mother gloss, but does not itself date those senses or establish their development sequence.
evidence.title: [A00958] 媽 — Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 2012, 天津古籍出版社／遼寧人民出版社
evidence.field: PDF p. 951; printed p. 936; 怕 headword paragraph; scan /home/catalin/hanzi-etymology-books/research-ocr/ziyuan-full/page-0951/source.png; source pixel SHA-256 1d7222e6fda971d2d1ee360e66c86e1e54516956f7315d216a3ee76d461d0822
evidence.text: I inspected the original page pixels. Under the 怕 headword, the passage says its colloquial reading history is analogous to using 爸妈 instead of 父母: initials and finals changed over time in speech while older readings continued in the literary register. This is a pronunciation analogy only; it gives no etymology, historical reading, or component analysis for 妈. No OCR correction is proposed.
evidence.title: 《字源》, 李學勤主編 (2012)

search_audit.query: site:zdic.net/hans/妈 妈 字形结构 字形分析 女 马; 媽 女 馬 形聲 current structure dictionary 教育部
search_audit.outcome: Searched and opened 汉典’s 妈 entry and Taiwan MOE’s 媽 character-variant entry. 汉典 explicitly gives the current graph analysis 从女、马声 and unmarked mother and female-elder senses. MOE confirms traditional 媽’s visible 女/M馬 sides, says it is absent from Shuowen, and cites the 龍龕手鑑 mother gloss.

search_audit.query: Repository 字源 corpus occurrences of 妈/媽 and the supplied PDF p. 951 candidate
search_audit.outcome: Searched the local provisional OCR corpus. Candidate PDF p. 951 is a 怕 entry whose paragraph contains 爸妈 only as a spoken-reading analogy; no 妈/媽 headword or etymology occurs there. I inspected the source scan pixels for that page. The corpus also contains index/reference mentions, which are not a headed 媽 entry.

gaps: The visible 女 and 馬 sides of current 媽 are directly confirmed by the MOE entry, and current 妈 is directly analyzed as 女 plus 马 by 汉典. These sources do not establish a paleographic sequence or ancient graphic origin; MOE reports 媽 absent from Shuowen and marks several early-script reference categories unavailable.
字源, PDF p. 951 (printed p. 936), supports only the 爸妈/父母 pronunciation analogy in the 怕 entry. It does not support claims about 妈’s formation, sound history, or earliest attestation.
